_comments: Copy to ~/.opensession/config.json or point OPENSESSION_CONFIG at it.
Environment variables override config values. Repositories are authoritative: when `repos` is present, only those entries are registered.
With no `repos` configured, a server install registers this Open Session checkout itself as a shared `opensession` repo. Set `repos` for real team projects.
External integrations and instance seed routines are opt-in (`enabled: true`).

selfDev controls sessions on the self-hosted Open Session repo itself: 'shared' (default) = all sessions edit the live shared checkout on the default branch; 'worktree' = self-sessions get isolated worktrees + the normal branch/PR flow like every other repo.

Repos are GitHub-hosted by default. To host one on code.storage instead, set host: 'codestorage' and csRepo (the repo id/path) on the repo entry — see the 'widget-cs' example — and configure integrations.codestorage (org + PKCS8 private key that signs the customer-issued JWTs).

widget.label: Widget
widget.description: Acme's main product application and API.
widget.securityInstructions: Read SECURITY.md before triaging findings; run bun test for changed packages.

widget-cs._comment: Example code.storage-hosted repo (delete or fill in): no ghRepo/PRs — branches are reviewed against defaultBranch and merged via the code.storage merge API. Requires integrations.codestorage below.
widget-cs.label: Widget (code.storage)

codestorage._comment: code.storage git host (docs/setup/codestorage.md). org = the <org>.code.storage subdomain and JWT issuer; privateKeyPath = PKCS8 PEM (ES256 or RS256) whose public key is registered with code.storage; apiBase is optional and defaults to https://api.<org>.code.storage/api; webhookSecret (optional) verifies inbound POST /codestorage/webhook deliveries.

runnersBootstrap._comment: Optional protected operator inventory for Settings → Runners migration. SSH needs a pinned SHA256 host fingerprint and a dedicated known-hosts file. Kubernetes credentials must be restricted to the named Runner namespace/workload and a reviewed Deployment plus persistent-volume manifest. Do not put private keys, kubeconfig content, pairing tokens, or arbitrary commands here.

automations.name: Weekly dependency review
automations.prompt: Review dependency updates in the configured repository. Report actionable upgrades and open a focused PR only when the repository policy permits it.
